narrative_purpose: Makes the carbon-beats-silicon argument visible in one glance: carbon's waste leaves as a clean gas, silicon's waste is solid rock that would brick a body shut — the single image that carries why life is carbon, not silicon.
subject: A split-panel naturalist comparison. Left panel: a softly glowing living lung-like form exhaling a clear faint cyan vapour that rises and dissolves cleanly into the air — waste leaving as a gas. Right panel: a mirror-image lung-like form choked with rough opaque quartz-like crystalline rock growing inside it, jagged pale crystals clogging the airways and spilling out, frozen solid and unable to escape.
scene: Two paired specimen forms side by side against deep dark, divided by a thin band of haze, presented like two outcomes of the same experiment.
camera: A straight-on paired study view, both forms at equal size for direct comparison.
light: Cool bioluminescent key on the left form and its rising vapour; a colder, flatter light on the right form catching the hard facets of the choking quartz; deep indigo shadow around both.
palette: Void-indigo ground; the living left form in living teal and Pandora cyan with a clean cyan vapour; the right form's quartz in desaturated stone-grey and mist-white, deliberately lifeless; warm accent absent to keep the right side cold and dead.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the clean rising vapour (left) and the jagged choking crystals (right); backgrounds soft.
composition: Two equal vertical panels with a dark central seam; a clear dark zone above each form for an overlaid callout.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette; the left reads alive and breathing, the right reads petrified and dead — the visual argument is gas-escapes versus rock-traps.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no chemical formulae, no molecular ball-and-stick diagrams, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
